title: Nonlocal Fisher information: lifting, local limit, and the Blachman-Stam inequality
summary: We show that the nonlocal Fisher information - defined as the entropy dissipation of the Boltzmann entropy for nonlocal heat equations - admits a natural lifting in the sense of Guillen and Silvestre (2025). Important examples include the discrete Fisher information arising in Markov chains and the fractional Fisher information $i_s$ associated with the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^{s}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, $s\in (0,1)$.
